clauses: This biochemist and university teacher has made significant contributions to the fields of biochemistry and molecular biology.

Over the course of a distinguished career, this scientist received the Canada Gairdner International Award, the National Medal of Science, the NAS Award in Molecular Biology, and an honorary doctorate from Harvard University.

Despite a highly decorated academic path, this individual never pursued their education at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, nor did they ever serve as the President of Rockefeller University.
